[26.1 更新移植信息](https://wiki.chaotictrials.de/porting/version/26.1/) **[![#与乌克兰站在一起](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vshymanskyy/StandWithUkraine/main/banner2-direct.svg)](https://vshymanskyy.github.io/StandWithUkraine)** ![Header](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ChaoticTrials/ModMeta/HEAD/assets/mods/aiot-botania/header.png)
![概述](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ChaoticTrials/ModMeta/HEAD/assets/mods/aiot-botania/overview.png)
![创意模式标签页](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ChaoticTrials/ModMeta/HEAD/assets/mods/aiot-botania/creative_tab.png) 元素镐/AIOT 不仅会创建耕地，还会创建*超级耕地*。它不需要水，即使从高处落下也不会变成泥土。还有那粉色的火花，*哇*！关于各个物品的更多信息可以在 **Lexica Botania**（博塔尼亚法典）中找到。 ![超级耕地预览](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ChaoticTrials/ModMeta/HEAD/assets/mods/aiot-botania/super_farmland_preview.gif)
![合成表](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ChaoticTrials/ModMeta/HEAD/assets/mods/aiot-botania/recipes.png)
点击展开 **元素 AIOT** ![元素 AIOT 合成表](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ChaoticTrials/ModMeta/HEAD/assets/mods/aiot-botania/recipes/elementium_aiot.png) **活岩剪刀** ![活岩剪刀合成表](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ChaoticTrials/ModMeta/HEAD/assets/mods/aiot-botania/recipes/livingrock_shears.png) **活木剪刀** ![活木剪刀合成表](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ChaoticTrials/ModMeta/HEAD/assets/mods/aiot-botania/recipes/livingwood_shears.png)
你可以将此模组放入任何你喜欢的整合包中。 ![[广告](https://www.bisecthosting.com/melanx)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ChaoticTrials/ModMeta/HEAD/assets/mods/aiot-botania/promo.png) #广告 #Ad
